rows.text: Venser has flash and bounces a SPELL, so he is a hard counter that leaves a 2/2 Wizard behind. Everything else in the deck exists to make that trigger happen again — blink him, copy him, double his trigger — until the table cannot resolve anything. And because he is a Wizard, the tribal payoffs that tap Wizards for value are all live at the same time.

rows.name: Venser, Shaper Savant
rows.text: flash, and his enters trigger returns a target spell OR permanent to its owner's hand. Hold four mana and he answers a wrath, a combo piece or a commander at instant speed.

rows.name: Naban, Dean of Iteration
rows.text: if a WIZARD entering triggers an ability of a permanent you control, it triggers again. Venser is a Wizard, so every arrival bounces two things.

rows.name: Panharmonicon
rows.text: the same doubling for any creature or artifact.

rows.name: Roaming Throne
rows.text: name Wizard. A third doubler, on a ward {2} body.

rows.name: Archmage of Echoes
rows.text: copies every Faerie or Wizard PERMANENT spell you cast. Casting Venser makes two Vensers and two bounces.

rows.name: Displacer Kitten
rows.text: every noncreature spell you cast blinks a permanent you control. Point it at Venser and each counterspell, each cantrip, each removal spell also bounces something of theirs. This is the deck's engine.

rows.name: Conjurer's Closet
rows.text: a free blink every end step, forever.

rows.name: Essence Flux
rows.text: one mana.

rows.name: Displace
rows.text: two creatures at once, at instant speed.

rows.name: Blur
rows.text: a blink and a card.

rows.name: Planar Incision
rows.text: a blink that leaves a +1/+1 counter, and it works on artifacts too.

rows.name: Dour Port-Mage
rows.text: bounces one of your own creatures every turn for {1}{U}, and draws whenever your creatures leave without dying.

rows.name: Barrin, Tolarian Archmage
rows.text: bounces a creature or planeswalker on arrival, and draws at end step whenever a permanent went to your hand from the battlefield — which this deck does every single turn.

rows.name: Aether Channeler
rows.text: three modes, all of which are fine, and all of which double under Naban.

rows.name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
rows.text: tap any untapped Wizard to draw a card. On a board of five Wizards that is five cards a turn.

rows.name: Patron Wizard
rows.text: tap a Wizard to tax every spell they cast. Alongside Azami it makes your board a soft counterspell wall.

rows.name: Galecaster Colossus
rows.text: tap a Wizard to bounce any nonland permanent they control. With enough Wizards it is a one-sided board wipe every turn.

rows.name: Sage of Fables
rows.text: every other Wizard arrives with a +1/+1 counter, and counters convert into cards.

rows.name: Docent of Perfection
rows.text: a Wizard token per instant or sorcery, then it flips into an anthem that keeps making them.

rows.name: Kindred Discovery
rows.text: name Wizard. A card for every Wizard that enters AND every one that attacks — and this deck flickers Wizards constantly.

rows.name: Herald's Horn
rows.text: Wizards cost one less and it digs for them each upkeep.

rows.name: Patchwork Banner
rows.text: an anthem plus fixing.

rows.name: Psychosis Crawler
rows.text: each opponent loses a life for every card you draw. With Azami running that is lethal quickly.

rows.name: Counterspell
rows.text: the clean two-mana answer.

rows.name: Mana Drain
rows.text: counter, and the mana casts Venser at instant speed.

rows.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
rows.text: one mana for anything noncreature.

rows.name: Glen Elendra Archmage
rows.text: a repeatable counterspell for noncreature spells, twice thanks to persist.

rows.name: Glen Elendra Guardian
rows.text: flash, flies, and counters a noncreature spell while drawing them a card they do not need.

rows.name: Pongify
rows.text: one mana, kills anything.

rows.name: Rapid Hybridization
rows.text: the second copy.

rows.name: Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: overloaded, the clear for a lethal Wizard attack.

rows.name: Raise the Palisade
rows.text: name Wizard and every other creature at the table goes back to hand.

rows.name: Cyclone Summoner
rows.text: cast from hand, it returns ALL permanents except Giants, Wizards and lands. Your board survives; nobody else's does.

rows.name: Master of Waves
rows.text: protection from red, an anthem, and a pile of Elemental tokens scaled to your devotion.

rows.name: Rhystic Study
rows.text: their turns pay for your instant-speed turns.

rows.name: Mystic Remora
rows.text: the best card in the deck on turns one through four.

rows.name: Archaeomancer
rows.text: returns an instant or sorcery on entry, and blinks for another every turn.

rows.name: Emeritus of Ideation
rows.text: a 5/5 flier that also carries an Ancestral Recall.

rows.name: Candlekeep Sage
rows.text: your commander draws a card whenever he enters OR leaves — so every blink is two cards.

rows.name: Sapphire Medallion
rows.text: everything costs one less.

rows.name: Mind Stone

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep mana and a cheap Wizard. The deck wants to be holding up four mana from turn four onwards, and Venser is only a counterspell if you can actually cast him at instant speed.

Cast Venser on THEIR turn whenever possible. Bouncing a spell off the stack is strictly better than bouncing a permanent, and holding him up costs you nothing because he is also your best blocker-answer.

rows.name: Displacer Kitten
rows.text: prioritise her over any single Wizard. With Venser on the battlefield she turns every cheap blue spell in the deck into a two-for-one.

rows.name: Naban, Dean of Iteration
rows.text: two mana, and he doubles the most important trigger in the deck. Play him before you start blinking, not after.
